subject.title: Sort & filter chat sessions in the companion app by recency, isIdle, isCompleted

question: Should the companion app add an explicit idle/completed filter control on top of the current Show completed toggle, or should the remaining behavior stay under the broader completed-session clutter work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/881?
rationale: Current main already made one UX choice by hiding clean completed sessions by default; adding idle filtering changes the visible session model and needs a maintainer-approved state vocabulary and control design.

options.title: Add scoped session-state filters
options.body: Define idle/completed filter semantics against `SessionInfo.Status`, then add focused UI and tests on the Sessions page.

options.title: Fold into the clutter issue
options.body: Treat this as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/881 so archive, hide, and filtering behavior are designed together.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Retain recency sorting plus Show completed only, and close or narrow this request if idle filtering is not desired.

recommendation.title: Add scoped session-state filters
recommendation.body: Define idle/completed filter semantics against `SessionInfo.Status`, then add focused UI and tests on the Sessions page.

likelyOwner.reason: This person most recently implemented and tested the completed-session visibility behavior that this issue would extend.
